n, k, MO = map(int, input().split())

def pw(x, y):
    t = 1
    while y:
        if y & 1:
            t = t * x % MO
        x = x * x % MO
        y >>= 1
    return t

def P(x, y):
    return fac[x] * inv[x - y] % MO

# Read input values
# The original code reads n, k, MO from input
# Already done above

if n & 1:
    print(pw(k, n))
    exit()

fac = [1] * (n + 1)
for i in range(1, n + 1):
    fac[i] = fac[i - 1] * i % MO

inv = [1] * (n + 1)
inv[n] = pw(fac[n], MO - 2)
for i in range(n - 1, -1, -1):
    inv[i] = inv[i + 1] * (i + 1) % MO

t = n
a = []
s = 0
for i in range(21):
    if t & 1:
        a.append(1 << i)
        s += 1
    t >>= 1

N = 1 << s
S = [0] * N
for i in range(N):
    for j in range(s):
        if (i >> j) & 1:
            S[i] += a[j]

p = [0] * N
for i in range(N):
    t_idx = -1
    for j in range(21):
        if (i >> j) & 1:
            t_idx = j
    p[i] = (1 << (t_idx + 1)) + i

f = [[0] * N for _ in range(k + 1)]
f[0][0] = 1

for i in range(k):
    for j in range(N):
        if f[i][j]:
            k_idx = p[j]
            k_mask = k_idx
            while k_mask < N:
                f[i + 1][k_mask] = (f[i + 1][k_mask] + f[i][j] * inv[S[k_mask ^ j]]) % MO
                k_mask = (k_mask + 1) | j

ans = 0
for i in range(k + 1):
    ans = (ans + f[i][N - 1] * P(k, i)) % MO

ans = ans * fac[n] % MO
ans = (pw(k, n) - ans + MO) % MO
print(ans)
